messages.snippet: As part of our security review, all staff must reset their network passwords before Monday 24 March.
messages.subject: [IT] Mandatory password reset this weekend
messages.plaintextBody:
As part of our security review, all staff must reset their network passwords before Monday 24 March. You will be prompted at next login. Passwords must be at least 14 characters. Contact the helpdesk on x4357 if you have issues.

IT Helpdesk
